summary: Three linked Sima Bao flight/death and earlier recruitment source-context repairs: retain existing AD346 one-sided bounds and make their narrative basis explicit. Partial uninstalled proposal; no date approval.

before.unresolvedReason: s0242 遣其將陰監逆保 has no year. It follows s0234 是歲…建興六年 (AD 318) and precedes undated s0243 會保薨. Tongjian dates Bao's death 太興三年五月; Jin Shu does not close 320 as a second endpoint.
before.event: Sent to intercept Sima Bao, publicly as an escort but in truth to block his flight into Hexi.

sourceDate.text: 遣其將陰監逆保，聲言翼衛，實禦之也 (s0242 in Sima Bao’s flight sequence after s0234 元帝即位/建興六年, conventional onOrAfter AD318); exact interception year unstated

after.event: Sent to intercept Sima Bao, publicly as an escort but in truth to block his flight into Hexi.

changes.reason: s0234 explicitly introduces Yuan’s accession and Jianxing6; s0235 then has Bao hear Min’s death and style himself king. 俄而 in s0236 and 未幾 in s0239 connect Bao’s subsequent defeats and appeals for help. s0241 has Bao plan flight to Zhang Shi; s0242 names Yin Jian as the general Shi sends to intercept him. This is Yin Jian’s own mission in that post-accession narrative, supporting the existing onOrAfter AD318 floor. The event supplies no exact mission year or upper endpoint; the separate subsequent 會保薨 notice is not converted into an imported320 endpoint.

before.unresolvedReason: s0257 writes 建興初, not 建興元年. 初 is an era-opening label, not year 1, and is not a closed AD 313 interval.

sourceDate.text: 建興初，南陽王保辟從事中郎，又薦為散騎侍郎、中壘將軍 (s0257 in Zhang Mao’s earlier-career backstory, followed by distinct 二年 appointment s0258); conventional onOrAfter AD313, exact recruitment year unstated

changes.reason: The heading and opening at s0255–s0256 introduce Zhang Mao’s biography; s0257 then explicitly places Prince of Nanyang Bao’s invitation and recommendations in 建興初. s0258 二年 is a separate court appointment refused because Mao’s father was old, and s0260 later names 太興三年 after Zhang Shi’s death. These anchors distinguish the earlier recruitment from Bao’s later flight/death narrative and identify Min’s Jianxing-era context. Preserve the existing onOrAfter AD313 floor for Bao’s own recruiting/recommending act. 初 remains an opening-period label, not an exact Jianxing1 year, and the distinct 二年 appointment is retained without assigning its exact year to Bao’s invitation.

before.unresolvedReason: s0243 會保薨 has no year. It follows 保聞湣帝崩 and the 是歲 / 太興 accession (AD 318) and supplies no later Chinese year such as 太興三年.
before.event: Died while planning to flee to Zhang Shi; more than ten thousand of his followers drifted into Liangzhou.

sourceDate.text: 會保薨，其眾散奔涼州者萬餘人 (s0243 after Bao’s flight/interception sequence s0235–s0242 following s0234 元帝即位/建興六年); conventional onOrAfter AD318, exact death year unstated

after.event: Died while planning to flee to Zhang Shi; more than ten thousand of his followers drifted into Liangzhou.

changes.reason: s0243 directly attests Bao’s death with 會保薨 and reports the dispersal of his followers. It follows his plan to flee to Zhang Shi at s0241 and Shi’s attempted interception at s0242, connected by the repeated named Bao to the post-s0234 accession sequence beginning with his response to Min’s death at s0235. The existing onOrAfter AD318 bound therefore dates Bao’s own death conservatively; this is not a later reception record or another ruler’s event. Preserve the exact death wording, with no exact320 year, Gregorian date, reign interval or latest endpoint imported from the retained Tongjian witness.
